summary: One reusable confirm dialog: call Show with a message and callbacks.
overview: A singleton yes/no dialog, so you stop hand-building a new popup every time something needs confirming.
useCases: Any yes/no question that does not deserve its own screen.

gotchas.title: It must never hide by deactivating its own GameObject
gotchas.body: A Singleton finds its instance with FindObjectOfType, which skips inactive objects — so deactivating itself makes Instance silently create a second, empty one. It hides with a CanvasGroup for exactly this reason. This was a real bug in this toolkit, not a hypothetical.

gotchas.title: One dialog at a time
gotchas.body: Showing a second while one is open replaces the first, and the first's callbacks never fire.
